dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing initiating at the mid-axial point and progressing continuously toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey mottling observed along the lateral margins and the posterior third of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the primary light-grey baseline and darker posterior pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, low-contrast linear marks (rake marks) oriented both longitudinally and diagonally across the central dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring/rake marks are visible on the mid-dorsal region.
